नेय a.
—1 To be led, managed, guided, governed.
—2 Fit to be taught; Mb. 5. 74. 4 (com. अनेयः शिक्षयितुमयोग्यः).
—3 To be spent or passed (as time).

नेय + -अर्थ, -अर्थक a. (a word or sentence) having a sense
 that can be only guessed; ग्राम्योऽप्रतीतसन्दिग्धनेयार्थनिहतार्थता S. D.
